output: Print the size of the largest subset of a1,a2,…,an$$$a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$$$ that counts.
note: In the first test, the set {1,2}$$$\{1,2\}$$$ counts, since 1⊕2=3$$$1 \oplus 2 = 3$$$, while max(1,2)=2$$$\max(1, 2) = 2$$$, and 3>2$$$3  \gt  2$$$.
